Description: Capacitor, 0.1 µF ±10%, 50 V, X7R ceramic, radial, 5.08 mm leads
Notes: Decoupling. 50 V is the usual stock rating and costs the same; any 16 V+ X7R with 5 mm leads fits. Alt: TDK FG28X7R1E104KRT06 (25 V).
J2 VIA port B, J3 port A. Or break both from one 1 × 40 strip (PRPC040SAAN-RC).

Description: D-sub, 25 positions (DB-25), female, right angle, through hole, with board locks
Notes: Check the fit before ordering. KiCad drew this footprint from a Tonar part, with the front pin row 9.9 mm from the board edge and the mounting holes 11.32 mm back. Right-angle DB-25s come with several such offsets (L77SDB25S1ACH4F is the common 0.318" type). Compare the datasheet's dimensions, or print the footprint 1:1 and lay the connector on it.
J5 SCL_EN, J6 SDA_EN (the I2C pull-ups).

Description: Resistor, 4.7 kΩ, 1/4 W, 5%, carbon film, axial, mini size (body about 3.3 mm)
Notes: This footprint's holes are only 5.08 mm apart (DIN0204), so it needs a small-body resistor: a standard 1/4 W (6.3 mm body) won't lie flat. The CFM14 is Stackpole's mini 1/4 W.

The S version drives IRQB high and low (totem pole), which is right when its IRQ has its own input on the priority encoder. If it ever shares a wired-OR IRQ line, use the W65C22N6TPG-14 (open drain) instead. Mouser is WDC's main distributor.

Description: I2C bus controller, parallel interface, PCF8584, DIP-20
Notes: Discontinued in DIP: expect to buy it from eBay, Rochester Electronics or a broker. The SO-20 version (PCF8584T) is still around, on an SOIC-to-DIP adapter if need be.
The PLD comes out for reprogramming; the PCF8584 is hard to replace.
